why: A composite service (SoPIoT vocabulary) is an abstract operation with a
post-condition contract and per-device *realizations* — concrete call
sequences certified to satisfy the contract. Substitution is judged and
performed at composite granularity: a device can replace another for a
role iff it has a certified realization of every composite the role uses.
Realizations are compile-time adapters: instantiation splices the target
device's call sequence into the code; nothing is resolved at runtime.
A realization without a contract cannot exist in this file by schema;
certified=false realizations are usable only via fail-closed escalation.
_meta.certification: certified=true means the realization has an offline proof obligation discharged (M2.6-style); v0 marks the corpus-native sequences certified-by-construction since the source scenarios themselves passed the gate.

reach_target_temperature.contract: After the sequence, the device is powered and configured so room temperature moves toward `target` (down when mode=cool, up when mode=heat), closed-loop; a later stop() halts the effect.

AirConditioner.note: The 온습도 skeleton's three consecutive calls are exactly this realization; certified by the v1 gate on the source scenario.

humidify.contract: After the sequence, the device is powered and raising room humidity (closed-loop); a later stop() halts the effect.

purify_air.contract: After the sequence, the device is powered and lowering particulate/VOC levels (closed-loop); a later stop() halts the effect. The device's power state is readable as switch.switch.

indicate_state.contract: The device visibly assumes the colour (x, y); its current colour is readable back (currentX/currentY), so band guards can suppress redundant commands.
